label: partly_explained

reasons.text: A viral reel mentioning the serum surged 2 hours before volume rose, which supports genuine demand.
Order value is flat (₹778 → ₹797) while order count is 6.0x, which matches beauty's order-count-led festive pattern.
There is no website offer and no coupon use, so the size of the lift rests on the social signal alone.
7 complaint posts about delayed delivery point to dispatch strain. 81% new customers means little order history to lean on.
No Account Aggregator consent, so the baseline comes from category peers rather than this merchant's own history.

evidence_requests: Delivery confirmations (AWB and proof of delivery) for orders over ₹2,000
Current dispatch capacity: orders packed and shipped per day, and courier partner
merchant_message: Your demand looks real, but we need delivery proof for larger orders and your dispatch capacity.
